title: Managing Your Bluestone PIM Data Model with Terraform
description: The Terraform provider for Bluestone PIM now covers the full data model. Why we built it, what it manages, and how to start using it on an existing organization.
author: Michael van Tellingen

title: PIM Publishes. Your Database Catches Up.
description: A product page usually wants your own shape, joined with data PIM does not own. How and where should you maintain that? The solutions are as many as there are developers, but here is an overview of one way to solve this.
author: Viktor Lövgren

title: CLA, VLA, and Validation Reads in the Unofficial Bluestone PIM MCP Server
description: Six new read tools for category level attributes, variant level attributes, and sync validation issues. What they call, where they complement the UI for cross-product QA, and what you can ask in chat.
author: Viktor Lövgren

title: Trying the Unofficial Bluestone PIM MCP Server on a Real Catalog
description: What happens when an AI assistant can browse Bluestone PIM catalogs, compare draft and published data, switch language context, and fetch product images.
author: Viktor Lövgren

title: Welcome to Bluestone PIM Labs
description: What Labs is, why it exists, and what you can look forward to as we keep building.
author: Viktor Lövgren
